$schema-note: Words the site and both apps show (design/specs/2026-11-07-mobile-redesign.md section 2.2): one catalog, keys shared.*, the same value grammar as en.json. The web modules read it (web/src/lib/copy/shared.ts) and keep their own names and exports; web/scripts/gen-mobile-copy.mjs generates it into both apps beside en.json (Copy.shared* on iOS, R.string.shared_* on Android). A word that appears on the site and in an app lives here, never in en.json.

strings.shared.account.delete.title: Delete account
strings.shared.account.delete.question: Delete your account?
strings.shared.account.delete.line: Delete your account and the data that is only yours. The next step lists exactly what goes and what stays.
strings.shared.account.delete.deleted.title: Deleted
strings.shared.account.delete.deleted.subscripti: Any Premium subscription is cancelled at once. There is no automatic refund; the refund policy applies.
strings.shared.account.delete.deleted.identity: Your BattleTag, email and Battle.net sign-in. Every browser, companion and app is signed out.
strings.shared.account.delete.deleted.discord: Your Discord link and Premium role, notification settings and watch list.
strings.shared.account.delete.deleted.private: Your private reports, saved sims, addon exports, and characters known only from your addon.
strings.shared.account.delete.deleted.guild: Your guild memberships, applications and raid sign-ups.
strings.shared.account.delete.kept.title: Kept
strings.shared.account.delete.kept.billing: Stripe billing records, which we must keep for tax and legal reasons. Your link to them is removed.
strings.shared.account.delete.kept.reports: Public and guild reports, with your name removed.
strings.shared.account.delete.kept.characters: Character data from public sources, such as the Battle.net profile and public logs, no longer linked to you.
strings.shared.account.delete.kept.builds: Builds you shared, as anonymous links.
strings.shared.account.delete.lose.title: Billing and seats
strings.shared.account.delete.lose.premium: Your Premium plan is cancelled and does not renew.
strings.shared.account.delete.lose.founder: Your founder price is gone for good. A plan taken later is billed at the full price.
strings.shared.account.delete.storeWarning: Your Premium ends when the account is deleted. Cancel the subscription in the App Store or Google Play first, or you are billed again.
strings.shared.account.delete.email: You can also ask by email at help@foreversixty.gg.
strings.shared.account.delete.failed: Could not delete your account just now. Try again.
strings.shared.account.delete.done: Your account is deleted. Thanks for playing with us.
